description: Slack Enterprise Grid tools (54) for app.slack.com: messages, threads, search, channels and membership admin, users, files, pins, stars, reactions, bookmarks, user groups, reminders and Do Not Disturb — reads and writes. Uses your own logged-in enterprise Slack session in the current tab.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel or direct message. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting. To reply in a thread, use reply_to_thread instead.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Slack channel with optional date-range filtering and pagination. Returns messages in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read replies in a Slack thread. Returns all messages including the parent message, with optional pagination.

tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply to a message thread in Slack. Posts a reply linked to the specified parent message.

tools.name: react_to_message
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message. Use emoji name without colons (e.g., "thumbsup" not ":thumbsup:").

tools.name: update_message
tools.description: Edit an existing Slack message. The caller must be the original author of the message.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message from a Slack channel. The caller must be the original author, or the channel must allow message deletion. This action is permanent and irreversible.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search for messages across Slack channels with optional pagination and sorting. Supports Slack search modifiers (e.g., "from:@user in:#channel before:2024-01-01").

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files in Slack by name, type, or content. Returns file metadata including download URLs.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for users in the Slack workspace by name or email. Fetches the user list and filters client-side since the Slack Web API does not provide a dedicated user search endpoint.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Search for channels by name in the Slack workspace. Returns matching channels sorted by recent activity. Useful for finding channels by name pattern (e.g., "incident" to find all incident channels).

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List channels in the Slack workspace with type filtering, archive exclusion, and cursor-based pagination. Supports public_channel, private_channel, mpim (group DM), and im (1:1 DM) types.

tools.name: get_channel_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Slack channel including topic, purpose, and member count.

tools.name: list_channel_members
tools.description: List member user IDs of a Slack channel with cursor-based pagination. Returns user IDs — use get_user_info to resolve a specific user ID to a name/profile, or list_users to get all workspace users with names.

tools.name: open_dm
tools.description: Open a direct message conversation with one or more users. Returns an existing DM channel if one already exists, or creates a new one. For multi-person DMs (group DMs), pass multiple comma-separated user IDs.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel. Channel names must be lowercase, max 80 characters, using hyphens instead of spaces. On Enterprise Grid, the channel is created in the current workspace.

tools.name: archive_channel
tools.description: Archive a Slack channel. Archived channels are hidden from the channel list but messages are preserved. Members can still search archived channel history.

tools.name: unarchive_channel
tools.description: Unarchive a Slack channel, restoring it to the active channel list. All previous messages and members are preserved.

tools.name: set_channel_topic
tools.description: Set the topic of a Slack channel. The topic appears in the channel header and is visible to all members. Max 250 characters.

tools.name: set_channel_purpose
tools.description: Set the purpose/description of a Slack channel. The purpose describes what the channel is used for and appears in channel details. Max 250 characters.

tools.name: invite_to_channel
tools.description: Invite one or more users to a Slack channel. Invited users receive a notification and gain access to the full channel history.

tools.name: kick_from_channel
tools.description: Remove a user from a Slack channel. The user will be notified of the removal.

tools.name: rename_channel
tools.description: Rename a Slack channel. Names must be lowercase, max 80 chars, using hyphens instead of spaces.

tools.name: join_channel
tools.description: Join a public Slack channel. Only works for public channels — private channels require an invitation via invite_to_channel.

tools.name: leave_channel
tools.description: Leave a Slack channel. You will stop receiving notifications and the channel will be removed from your sidebar.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Slack user including name, display name, and admin status.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace with cursor-based pagination. Returns user IDs, names, admin status, and bot flag.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile including user ID, username, team name, and admin status.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Slack file including its metadata, file size, and download URL.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in the Slack workspace with optional filters for channel, user, and file type. Returns file metadata including download URLs.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a Slack channel. Supports UTF-8 text content or base64-encoded binary files. Maximum file size is 20MB. Executable file types are blocked.

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message to a Slack channel. Pinning posts a notification in the channel visible to all members.

tools.name: unpin_message
tools.description: Remove a pinned message from a Slack channel.

tools.name: list_pins
tools.description: List all pinned items in a Slack channel including messages and files.

tools.name: star_message
tools.description: Add a star to a Slack message for quick access later. Starred items appear in your saved items list.

tools.name: star_file
tools.description: Add a star to a Slack file for quick access later.

tools.name: unstar_message
tools.description: Remove a star from a Slack message.

tools.name: unstar_file
tools.description: Remove a star from a Slack file.

tools.name: list_stars
tools.description: List all starred/saved items for the authenticated user. On Enterprise Grid, tries the modern saved.list API first, then falls back to stars.list.

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message. Removes the authenticated user's reaction.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get all reactions on a Slack message with emoji names and user lists.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: List all bookmarks (pinned links) in a Slack channel. Bookmarks appear at the top of the channel and link to external resources like dashboards, runbooks, and documents.

tools.name: add_bookmark
tools.description: Add a bookmark (pinned link) to a Slack channel. Bookmarks appear at the top of the channel for quick access to external resources.

tools.name: remove_bookmark
tools.description: Remove a bookmark from a Slack channel. Use list_bookmarks to find bookmark IDs.

tools.name: list_user_groups
tools.description: List all user groups (handle groups) in the Slack workspace. User groups are @-mentionable teams like @engineering or @oncall-payments.

tools.name: list_user_group_members
tools.description: List member user IDs of a specific user group. Use list_user_groups to find group IDs, then get_user_info to resolve user IDs to names.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Update the current authenticated user's status text and emoji. Pass empty strings to clear the status. Optionally set an expiration time.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Create a new Slack reminder for the authenticated user. Specify the reminder text and when it should fire as a Unix timestamp.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List all reminders for the authenticated user, including pending and completed reminders.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a Slack reminder. Use list_reminders to find reminder IDs.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Mark a Slack reminder as complete. Use list_reminders to find reminder IDs.

tools.name: set_snooze
tools.description: Enable Do Not Disturb mode for the specified number of minutes. Pauses all notifications.

tools.name: end_snooze
tools.description: End the current Do Not Disturb snooze session and resume notifications.

tools.name: get_dnd_status
tools.description: Get the current Do Not Disturb status for the authenticated user, including scheduled DND times and active snooze status.
